description: We are Cosmora, a team of enthusiastic beginners interested in space exploration, science and technology. We are excited to learn, collaborate and create innovative solutions for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We welcome creative thinkers and passionate learners with interests in coding, software development, web development, graphic design and space science. Let's learn and innovate together!
summary:
AstroMission is an interactive educational game designed to help students understand the challenges of human space exploration. The game allows players to take the role of a mission commander and manage a space base on the Moon or Mars.

Players must manage important resources such as oxygen, food, electricity and radiation protection. They face different emergency situations and make decisions to keep astronauts safe. Each decision affects the resources and overall mission progress.

The project aims to make space science more interesting and accessible through interactive gameplay. It encourages critical thinking, decision-making and problem-solving while introducing students to the challenges of establishing a human settlement beyond Earth.
details: AstroMission is an interactive educational game designed to introduce students to the challenges of human space exploration on the Moon and Mars. The project focuses on astronaut survival and space-base management. Players take the role of a mission commander and make decisions to manage essential resources such as oxygen, food, electrical power and radiation protection. The game includes different mission scenarios and emergency situations. Players must make appropriate decisions to protect astronauts and complete their missions successfully. The project aims to improve problem-solving, critical thinking and decision-making skills while making space science more interesting and accessible to students. The proposed technologies are HTML, CSS and JavaScript. HTML is used to create the structure, CSS for the design and JavaScript for interactive gameplay and resource management. The creative aspect of AstroMission is its decision-based gameplay, where every choice can affect the mission outcome.
